# Example .txt Configuration File
# =============================================================================
# This file demonstrates the expected format for .txt configuration files
# Fields are validated against action-spec.json (config_schema.fields)
# Format is identical to .env files (key=value pairs)
# =============================================================================

# Required Fields (defined in action-spec.json)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
EXAMPLE_FIELD=example_value_here
ANOTHER_FIELD=another_value_here

# Optional Fields (defined in action-spec.json)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
OPTIONAL_FIELD=optional_value_here

# Notes:
# - Required fields MUST be present or validation will fail
# - Optional fields can be omitted
# - Values can be quoted or unquoted
# - Comments (lines starting with #) are ignored
# - Empty lines are ignored
#
# To customize for your action:
# 1. Update action-spec.json config_schema.fields with your fields
# 2. Replace EXAMPLE_FIELD, ANOTHER_FIELD with your actual field names
# 3. Update this example file to match your schema
